title: Instagram Auto Post Setup
goal: Caleb's Instagram account is set up for automatic posting via the Instagram Graph API with all required permissions and documentation.

project.why: Drafted 2026-09-25 by Aletheia's own model while the subscriptions were out, from something Caleb asked for; his to correct before or after he says yes.

steps.text: Create a Meta developer app for Instagram Graph API access.
Switch Caleb's Instagram account to a professional account.
Request the instagram_content_publish permission for the Meta app.
Generate a long-lived access token for the Meta app.
Write documentation on setting up the Instagram Graph API and required permissions.
